name: SAS Certified Professional: AI and Machine Learning

entry.name: SAS Certified Professional: AI and Machine Learning
entry.note: Awarded after three SAS specialist credentials: machine learning, forecasting and optimization, and natural language processing and computer vision
entry.renewal: Expires 5 years from the date earned
entry.audience: Analysts and data scientists working in SAS and open source tools

reading.format: Awarded after completing three SAS Certified Specialist credentials. No separate exam is described on this page.
reading.summary: This professional credential is awarded after earning three SAS Certified Specialist credentials in machine learning, forecasting and optimization, and natural language processing and computer vision. It validates skills in using open source and SAS tools to gain insight from data. Holding it shows ability in natural language processing and computer vision.
reading.audience: For people who want to expand career potential or stand out in a competitive field.
reading.validity: Expires five years from the date the certification is earned. Underlying credentials may expire at different times but do not cause this credential to expire earlier.
reading.prerequisites: Must earn SAS Certified Specialist: Machine Learning, SAS Certified Specialist: Forecasting and Optimization, and SAS Certified Specialist: Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision.
